pixel_convention: x right, y DOWN, origin top-left, full-resolution pixels

camera.motion: static (mean abs diff frame0 vs frame39 in untouched background = 0.04 grey levels); no per-frame background shift
camera.view: fronto-parallel view of a warehouse facade; floor seen from slightly above (floor band y~910-1080). Motion is in a plane facing the camera.
camera.perspective_note: forklift appears ~2-3% longer near the left image edge (frame 0: orange extent 256 px, wheelbase ~164 px) than near the image centre (frame 39: 250 px, ~159 px) - off-axis view of a 3D body (camera sees a little of the rear face). Its height (721->928) does not change, so depth is constant.

red_ball.description: small glossy red sphere, the only red object above the forklift; falls straight down at x~956 in front of the wall between the two concrete pillars
red_ball.visible_frames: 0-38 fully (37-38 slightly motion-blurred); 39 occluded behind forklift mast (only red slivers at x~952-960, y~752-765)
red_ball.diameter_note: bbox 19-22 px wide, 16-20 px tall (threshold loses the dark rim); visual edge-to-edge ~20-21 px at frame 0 (x 946-967, y 76-95)
red_ball.vertical_fit_check: y(frame) = 0.4508 f^2 - 0.260 f + 86.78 over frames 2-38, rms 0.41 px; i.e. constant pixel acceleration ~0.90 px/frame^2 (= ~519 px/s^2) downward; vertex at frame ~0.3

forklift.description: orange-and-black Toyota counterbalance forklift seen from its left side, forks pointing right (direction of travel); only vehicle in the scene
forklift.visible_frames: 0-39, never occluded (passes in front of concrete pillar 1 at the end)
forklift.reference_point: x = frame-0 bbox centre (170.5) + rigid template-matching shift of the body (sub-pixel); y = bbox centre 824.5 (constant; it drives on a level floor). The rig root's exact location within the body is unknown but any body-fixed point gives the same displacements.
forklift.length_note: rear of orange counterweight to tip of fork tines, frame 0 (x 43-298). Same measure is 250 px at frame 39 (perspective/rear-face effect, see camera.perspective_note); 250-256 px, mid-clip ~254
forklift.height_note: top of overhead guard y 721 to tyre ground contact y 928 (+-2 px); constant over the clip
forklift.net_shift_px: 703.9 (template) / 704.5 (counterweight hole) / 698 rear edge / 692 tine tip / 700-705 wheels

concrete_pillar_1.note: light grey, left of the ball; forklift ends in front of it

concrete_pillar_2.note: light grey, right of the ball

static_objects.horizontal_steel_beams: dark bands at y~195-215, ~435-470, ~670-700 and ceiling beam y~35-75

doorway.note: dark opening below the ball, behind the glass curtain wall

static_objects.floor_edge_and_lines: facade base / kerb y~910-925; white horizontal floor lines at y~926-928, ~938-942, ~1015-1020, ~1036-1041

floor_parking_stripes.note: four groups of 2-3 slanted/vertical white stripes, y~945-1015

static_objects.diagonal_cross_braces: X-bracing in each wall bay (two tiers, y~210-430 and ~490-665)

events.note: frames 0 and 1 are identical for the ball and the forklift
first displacement between frames 1 and 2 (1.4 px); parabola vertex at frame ~0.3, so release is between frame 0 and 1

events.event: forklift starts moving (from rest, accelerating right)
events.note: first displacement between frames 1 and 2 (1.3 px); then steadily increasing per-frame steps (~0.9 px/frame^2, noisier than the ball)

events.event: forklift front (tine tip) reaches the ball's column x~946
ball passes behind the forklift mast/overhead guard (occluded, no visible bounce or deflection)
clip ends with both still moving; forklift never stops, ball never lands in view
